messages:
Maya Lee: hey team, quick weird one on first-day setup. I completed OOBE using my phone hotspot but had my company VPN app auto-connected. Kandji said enrollment succeeded but my mac shows a local account only and Okta Devices is empty. Also trying to install Homebrew hits sudo: permission denied. any ideas? :confused:

Ishaan (IT): welcome Maya! VPN during OOBE can sometimes break the SSO/code-exchange flow. Can you paste the Kandji enrollment message text and run `sudo fdesetup status` and `id -u`? also, are you seeing the corporate login at the macOS lock screen?

Maya Lee: kandji message was just "Enrollment complete". `sudo fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is Off". `id -u` -> 501. lock screen shows my local account (maya.lee) not the network account.

Kandji-bot: Enrollment recorded for "Maya Lee - MacBookAirModern" at 2026-11-28T08:12:33Z. Applied blueprint: "New Hire - Mac".

Jordan (Device Admin): yep this matches a VPN/OOBE edge case we've seen: Kandji can provision profiles but the managed mobile account creation relies on an Okta SSO token exchange during the first login. If the VPN rewrites outbound addresses or injects an HTTP proxy, the token callback can fail and the device falls back to creating a local account. Two options to fix: (A) re-run the managed account join flow locally (preferred), or (B) re-enroll on an unproxied network.

Ishaan (IT): Jordan, can you paste the quick commands for Maya? I'll stand by remotely.

Jordan (Device Admin): Maya, try this sequence (Terminal):

```
# disable VPN and ensure direct network or hotspot without VPN
sudo pkill -f "company-vpn" || true
# force MDM to reattempt account bind
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
# then run our helper to create the managed account if the token is present
sudo /usr/local/bin/rise-bind-account --user maya.lee
```

If rise-bind-account isn't present, ping me here and I can trigger the same from the console. After that, run `dscl . -read /Users/maya.lee` and `id -u maya.lee` to confirm it's a mobile account (should show AuthenticationAuthority including ;Managed;).

Maya Lee: ok disabling VPN now... ran profiles renew and then rise-bind-account returned: "Okta token present, creating mobile account". dscl shows AuthenticationAuthority: ;AppleToken; ;Managed; and `id -u maya.lee` now 502.

Ishaan (IT): nice. can you try a sudo command that required admin? e.g. `sudo /bin/ls` — should prompt for your Okta SSO password via the normal dialog.

Maya Lee: ran `sudo /bin/ls` and it accepted my corporate password prompt. Homebrew install proceeds now. FileVault still off though.

Jordan (Device Admin): FileVault may not have been triggered during the failed token window. Run `sudo fdesetup enable -user "maya.lee"` and choose "Institutional recovery key" when prompted; i'll then run the Kandji SyncRecoveryKey action to escrow.

Maya Lee: running fdesetup now... prompted and chose institutional.

Okta-bot: Device record updated for serial C02MAYAX123 at 2026-11-28T08:25:12Z. Device appears in Okta Devices.

Kandji-bot: Received SyncRecoveryKey request for device serial C02MAYAX123.

Jordan (Device Admin): initiating SyncRecoveryKey from console... done. Recovery escrow succeeded. FileVault status should now be "On" after encryption starts.

Maya Lee: `sudo fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is On." woo! thanks.

Helpdesk Bot: Ticket #INC-2026-1183 opened (Jordan) to add VPN note to New Hire KB: "Avoid auto-connecting VPN during OOBE; if you did, disable VPN and run profiles renew + rise-bind-account."

Ishaan (IT): adding to checklist too. Maya, welcome aboard and glad that worked :tada:

Maya Lee: huge thanks everyone! saved me a panic. excited to start :smile:
